name: Voxel Cone Tracing for Ambient Occlusion
aliases: Ambient Occlusion via Voxel Cone Tracing
definition: Ambient occlusion A(p) at a surface point p is defined as the visibility integral over the hemisphere Ω (above the surface) with respect to the projected solid angle.
summary: Voxel Cone Tracing for Ambient Occlusion is a real-time technique that approximates ambient occlusion by partitioning the hemisphere into cones and tracing them through a voxel grid, differing from SDF methods by enabling efficient storage of complex geometry.
